issues.on_page: Other income 2,031,461 (Total Nonmajor), of which Keno fund column 1,882,957 (92.7%)
issues.issue: [fixed] The combining schedule shows this line is almost entirely Keno fund proceeds (Keno column, p20). Under the more-than-half rule it should be keno/lottery (detail_category keno/lottery), not other/miscellaneous revenue.

issues.on_page: Other income 3,762,040; Nonmajor column 2,031,461 includes Keno fund 1,882,957 (p20) = 50.05% of the line
issues.issue: [fixed] Keno proceeds are just over half of this statement line (1,882,957 of 3,762,040), so the more-than-half rule calls for keno/lottery (or a split with split_from p20). This is borderline; flagged because the rule is explicit.

issues.on_page: General Fund combining schedule sub-fund columns: Veterans Aid Fund - Public health and human services 11,003, Transfers in 20,000; Broadband Fund - General government 62,572, Transfers in 100,000; Elimination - Transfers in (120,000), Transfers out 120,000
issues.issue: [fixed] The General Fund budget schedule (pp12-14) covers only the General Fund column. The Veterans Aid and Broadband sub-funds are separately budgeted, and their budget pages (report pp85-86) are not trimmed. Under the county General Fund sub-fund rule, their lines should come into detail from the combining page p19. Without them, detail transfers do not net: GF transfers out 17,391,239 includes 120,000 sent to these sub-funds, with no matching inflow in detail.
The same label is categorized charges for services/fees in receipts[4] and detail[95] (rentals), but licenses and permits here. The rules require one category per label across the report.

issues.on_page: Taxes 120,655,538; Statement of Activities p4 lists property 90,455,323, inheritance 9,911,225, motor vehicle 12,303,348, lodging 4,536,131, in-lieu 1,892,089, occupation 10,980, nameplate 2,995, drug 5,241, gaming 1,768,569 (sum 120,885,901)
issues.issue: The breakdown is printed but differs from the fund statement line by 230,363 (accrual/unavailable-revenue difference). Leaving the line unsplit is defensible. A person may prefer a split with the difference absorbed in property tax.
State revenue in the county Highway Fund is most likely highway allocation. other state aid is defensible because the page doesn't say.
The label is printed with a typo ('sevices'). The extractor corrected it here but kept other printed typos (Administratve, Emrgency).
The amount matches its page. The report prints a $1 difference between the Federal Grants budget schedule and the governmental funds statement.

issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds (Internal Service Funds column only)
issues.issue: The only proprietary funds are internal service funds, which are governmental activities and not business-type. The figures match the page, but downstream users should know proprietary here is not enterprise data.
